description: Align Executor runtime scopes, Factory hydration, and HistoryLoader with normalized conversation identity. Action reuse: extend existing Executor/HistoryLoader entry points; no new Action because server scoping/hydration are runtime internals. Contract: workflow and BO precedence preserved; communication identity isolates provider/config/channel/person or author; incomplete scoped identity does not broaden to provider history/shared anonymous memory. Tests first for warm/cold cross-channel isolation and compatibility.
title: [zaq-354.3] Channel-scoped agent memory
